items.issue: Same underlying recording as formal mikey-approach-002.
The woman says she has an urgent matter, followed by a request for WeChat; phone actions and voluntariness are not continuously verified.
items.disposition: Honor the time limit immediately; do not infer contact consent or success from standing, a phone, or brief assent.

items.issue: After an uncertain next-weekend answer, the man asks about other men and frames competition.
items.disposition: Treat uncertainty as unresolved and avoid jealousy or competition pressure.

items.issue: The transcript includes age 24 and student status, but short turns were not independently diarized.
items.disposition: Do not rely on age or adulthood attribution without verified speaker turns; never infer age from appearance.

items.issue: The man guesses Vietnamese identity from appearance/context and links it to food preference.
items.disposition: Do not generalize ethnicity or nationality from appearance.

items.issue: A public participant and bystanders are recorded; consent to recording/publication is not shown.
items.disposition: Do not expose identity or reuse imagery without privacy and consent review.

items.issue: The edit does not verify contact saving, later replies or a meeting.
items.disposition: Do not count this as a successful contact or date.
